label: Multi-phase session-log capture and analysis tool build
description: Build a developer tool across phases from a markdown plan: capture hooks, parser, redaction, file-based store, review CLI, and later summarize and cluster modules. Each phase is committed after user approval, with unit tests.
type_rationale: Requires design decisions, interpretation of a plan, and iterative user feedback. Judgment is essential, so a skill is appropriate. Deterministic pieces such as the parser and store can be scripts it calls.
